integrity: A complete proof and a reproducible finite diagnostic are supplied; diagnostics do not constitute an infinite proof. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The proven uniform window has 0 <= (1-alpha)log n <= S fixed. No effective error bound, extension to alpha>1, nonradial kernels, or alpha approaching zero is asserted. Component positivity, fixed-parameter singularity analysis, and endpoint Gregory coefficients are credited as prior knowledge. General uniform renewal theory may contain an alternative implicit derivation.
title: A uniform logarithmic crossover for the complete-Pick coefficients of Dirichlet kernels
